notes.title: Price & Discount revealed!
notes.content:
[h3]Greeting mighty warriors, [/h3]

Thank you to all of you playing the demo for Might & Magic: Clash of Heroes - Definitive Edition!
While you wait for the full game to launch on July 20th, we wanted to show our gratitude to all the fans of the game by [u][b]extending the demo until July 10th[/b][/u]!

We also have another surprise! 

[h4][b]A 15% launch discount for 2 weeks
With an additional 40% off for original owners for 2 weeks[/b][/h4]

This means that you will have a total of [u][b]55% off[/b][/u] $17.99 for 2 weeks after launch if you owned the original game!

Thank you again, and enjoy a few more days in Ashan!

[b]Add Might & Magic: Clash of Heroes - Definitive Edition to your wishlist:[/b] 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2213300/Might__Magic_Clash_of_Heroes__Definitive_Edition/

https://www.instagram.com/dotemugames/
